mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP signals a demand shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumption and investment contract.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as companies cut hiring and wages.
failure_condition: Rank IC of UNRATE signal < 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production signals a supply-side expansion that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as companies increase output and profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months following positive INDPRO trend.
